name: etruncnorm
title: Mean. A far interval is the midpoint. The log cdf is SciPy's, because log(erf) underflows.

origin.description: Mean. A far interval is the midpoint. The log cdf is SciPy's, because log(erf) underflows.
origin.details: Means of a central interval, a far interval, a left tail, and a long left tail.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(truncnorm))
cat(paste(sprintf("%.17g", c(etruncnorm(-1, 1), etruncnorm(8, 9), etruncnorm(1, Inf), etruncnorm(-20, 0))), collapse = ","))
